GigaDevice.why: Fabless niche-DRAM (DDR4 / DDR3L / LPDDR4X), NOR and SLC NAND flash supplier whose memory revenue rises as major DRAM makers exit niche DRAM for HBM / DDR5
GigaDevice.evidence: GigaDevice 2026 half-year report: memory chip revenue +245.44% in H1 2026 as overseas majors exited niche DRAM and DRAM volume and price rose
GigaDevice.approved: user pre-approved 2026-10-01 for group scan_2026_10_01 (enrich_waitlist.json, group scan_2026_10_01)

players.product: Niche DRAM (DDR4, DDR3L, LPDDR4X) plus NOR flash and SLC NAND flash (fabless)

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue rose 178.67% YoY: memory supply was tight and GigaDevice's memory products rose in both volume and price (memory chip revenue +245.44%, led by niche DRAM and SLC NAND flash), while MCU revenue grew 49.07% on industrial, consumer and automotive demand. Net profit attributable rose 1,091.50%, including fair-value gains on securities held.

Niche DRAM: overseas majors are leaving the niche DRAM market as they shift to HBM and DDR5, leaving niche DRAM in short supply; in H1 2026 GigaDevice's DRAM volume and price both rose and gross margin improved markedly. DDR4 is in full mass production across niche applications (TV and projectors, networking, industrial, data-center infrastructure, smart home) and its self-developed LPDDR4X is progressing. SLC NAND (24nm / 38nm, 1Gb-8Gb) volume and price also rose as majors cut 2D NAND capacity, and the company is planning capacity expansion.

Outlook: management says all its memory products faced tight supply and rising prices in H1 2026. In DRAM it will push DDR4 4Gb/8Gb customer introduction in TV, industrial (e.g. power) and edge-AI customers, bring LPDDR4X to mass production and develop small-capacity LPDDR5; its customised-storage subsidiary Qingyun Technology expects some projects (AI phones, AI PCs, cars, robots) to reach mass production in H2 2026 and contribute revenue.

Supplier CXMT: GigaDevice bought raw materials and other items from CXMT and its subsidiaries (a related party: GigaDevice's chairman is also CXMT's chairman) under annual related-party transaction caps; it also holds a CXMT stake, listed on 27 July 2026, that it describes as a long-term strategic holding.
quarterly_data.figure: Purchases from CXMT RMB 1,986,235,896.02 in H1 2026 (H1 2025 RMB 433,482,227.93); payable to CXMT RMB 687,814,207.12; CXMT stake 1,085,672,415 shares (about 1.80%), cost RMB 2,300.0 million, fair value RMB 10,062.0 million (23.7% of total assets)
